haltingDifference.note: negative delta = fewer halted vehicles with the candidate controller

emissionsNote: Simulated estimates from SUMO's HBEFA3 model with an assumed fleet (see flowstate.experiments.emissions); not measurements of real urban emissions. Compare paired runs, do not quote absolute totals.

units.sim_t: s since the start of the observation (warm-up excluded)
units.density_veh_km_lane: vehicles per km of general-traffic lane
units.storage_occupancy: share of jam storage (7.5 m per vehicle-lane)
units.idle_co2_mg_s: mg/s emitted by stationary vehicles not at a planned stop
